idea-plugin.name: Redis Helper
idea-plugin.description:
Redis Helper is an open source IntelliJ-based Redis client for managing connections, browsing keys, editing values, and running Redis commands directly inside your IDE.

  • Manage standalone Redis connections, Redis Cluster connections, SSL/TLS connections, and SSH tunnel connections with password or private-key authentication.
  • Browse Redis databases, view key counts, and quickly find keys with filtering and grouping support.
  • Create, edit, rename, delete, and inspect String, List, Set, ZSet, and Hash values.
  • Use the redesigned Redis console with command history, searchable output, re-run support, copy actions, and improved command parsing.
  • Format values as JSON, XML, or HTML for easier reading and editing.
  • Load Redis INFO sections asynchronously and inspect server details without blocking the IDE.

If you have any suggestions, questions or bugs about this plugin, please issue them on Github, and if you like this plugin, just click the star on Github to show your support.
